# JPEG encoder attribution

The RGB user-image context path uses the unmodified registry package
`jpeg-encoder` 0.6.1, licensed `(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND IJG`.

this software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group

The complete original opening comment from the packaged `src/fdct.rs`, including
its copyright, no-warranty and distribution conditions, is retained byte-for-byte
in [jpeg-encoder-0.6.1-IJG.txt](jpeg-encoder-0.6.1-IJG.txt). The package has no
standalone IJG license file. The packaged [MIT license](jpeg-encoder-0.6.1-LICENSE-MIT) and
[Apache-2.0 license](jpeg-encoder-0.6.1-LICENSE-APACHE) are also retained unchanged. No upstream encoder source is modified here.
Retain this acknowledgement and the applicable upstream notices when distributing
source or binaries. This wrapper does not replace or relicense upstream code.
